FoldBridge.Checks.nat_side_example :: ∀ {p : Lampe.Prime} (h : Lampe.Fp p → Lampe.Fp p → Lampe.Fp p) (leaf a b c : Lampe.Fp p), LeanShieldedPool.Refine.LeanImt.merkleRoot (FoldBridge.Hn h) (ZMod.val leaf) 2 ⟨[true, false, true], rfl⟩ ⟨[ZMod.val a, ZMod.val b, ZMod.val c], rfl⟩ = FoldBridge.Hn h (FoldBridge.Hn h (ZMod.val a) (ZMod.val leaf)) (ZMod.val b)
